title: 🔥 WebGL Animated Glowing Heart Effect with Shaders | HTML & JavaScript
description:
💡 Want to create stunning visual effects with WebGL? In this tutorial, we craft an animated glowing heart effect using fragment shaders and WebGL. Learn how to:
✅ Set up WebGL and shaders 🎨
✅ Animate heart trails with Bezier curves
✅ Create a glowing effect with smoothstep()
✅ Optimize fragment shaders for performance

🖥️ This project is great for anyone learning computer graphics, shaders, or WebGL animation! Try it out and customize the colors, speed, and glow intensity! 💖

Tags:

#WebGL #Shaders #JavaScript #GLSL #Animation #Coding #HeartEffect #OpenGL #Frontend #CreativeCoding
shortDescription: Create a mesmerizing glowing heart animation ❤️ using WebGL shaders! This effect smoothly animates glowing trails, blending colors beautifully with fragment shaders. Perfect for learning WebGL, GLSL, and shader programming! 🚀
